author: Maxo1990
quote: A miserable 30 FPS slideshow wrapped around an absurd chore simulator. I work all day just to come home and relax, not play another game that feels like a second job. GTA 6 somehow turned fun into damn work.

author: Maxo1990
quote:
I’m really disappointed with Need for Speed Unbound. The game has minimized itself to the desktop multiple times while I was playing, and because of that I got caught by the police and lost all the money I had earned. 

Losing progress like that is extremely frustrating. On top of that, the game is full of bugs, and the police chases are completely overdone. Instead of feeling like a racing game, it often feels like you’re spending most of your time running from the cops. 

It feels like it should be called ‘Escape the Cops’ instead of Need for Speed. The actual driving can be fun, but the nonstop chases, technical issues, and bugs ruin the experience for me. I expected much better.

author: Maxo1990
quote: 10/10. Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 is an incredible sequel with amazing gameplay, a thrilling story, stunning visuals, and smooth web-swinging. Playing as both Peter and Miles is a blast, and every moment feels exciting. One of the best superhero games ever made!

quote: This is one of my favorite games of all time. No matter the genre/style of the game. This is what gaming is all about - gameplay, graphics, MUSIC, ATMOSPHERE. FH 3 has it all. quote: I made a Metacritic account for the first time in my life only to leave a review about this AMAZING game. I don’t understand how people can be hating on such an immersive, stealthy, BRILLIANT game. For real though, I don’t get it. Breakpoint and Wildlands are my all time favorite games!
